gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all issue type schemes available in Jira so that I can understand the configurations and options for my projects.
gold.ideal: The response should include a list of all issue type schemes with their IDs, names, and descriptions.

gold.user: As a Jira administrator, I want to create a new issue type scheme to better organize the issue types for my projects.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the creation of the issue type scheme and return its ID, name, and associated issue types.

gold.user: As a developer, I need to get the mapping of issue type schemes to projects to ensure that the correct issue types are available for each project.
gold.ideal: The response should provide a mapping of project IDs to their corresponding issue type scheme IDs.

gold.user: As a product owner, I want to know which issue type scheme is assigned to my project so that I can manage the issues effectively.
gold.ideal: The response should return the issue type scheme ID and name associated with the specified project.

gold.user: As a project administrator, I want to assign a specific issue type scheme to my project to customize the issue types available.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the assignment of the issue type scheme to the project and return the updated project details.

gold.user: As a Jira administrator, I need to delete an obsolete issue type scheme to keep the system organized and prevent confusion.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the deletion of the issue type scheme and indicate that it is no longer available.

gold.user: As a project manager, I want to update the details of an existing issue type scheme to reflect changes in our project requirements.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the update and return the modified issue type scheme details.

gold.user: As a Jira administrator, I want to add new issue types to an existing issue type scheme to enhance the options available for my projects.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the addition of the issue types and return the updated list of issue types in the scheme.

gold.user: As a project manager, I want to reorder the issue types in an issue type scheme to prioritize certain types for my team.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the new order of issue types in the scheme.

gold.user: As a Jira administrator, I need to remove an issue type from an issue type scheme that is no longer relevant to our projects.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the removal of the issue type and return the updated list of issue types in the scheme.
